results.title: Synthetic test data generation: Scalable, reliable, and powerful
results.content: 🎉 K2view named a **Visionary** in Gartner’s latest Magic Quadrant for Data Integration. ### K2view is a Visionary in the 2025 Gartner MQ 🎉. Discover why enterprises rely on synthetic test data generation to test their applications – at lower risk and higher scale – without endangering privacy. Synthetic test data generation is the way artificial data is created for software testing and quality assurance. Synthetic test data not only assures compliance with data protection regulations, it also covers a wider range of scenarios than real data and is available consistently, which facilitates more comprehensive testing and reduces reliance on scarce real-world data. Created via generative AI models, a roles engine, cloning, masking and more, synthetic data generation is a best practice for data privacy protection, as well as application testing and reliability. K2view is one of the only synthetic test data generation solutions to support all of these techniques.

results.content: # Synthetic Data Generation: 7 Best Practices for Enterprise Success. If you’re one of the companies with its sights set on synthetic data generation in 2025, this blog is for you. Before you move forward, we outline best practices to consider as you embark on your synthetic data generation journey, including specific factors to create a successful end result. Below we outline seven best practices to help you get off on the right foot and stay on the path to success. The type of data you have and how you use it will determine which type of synthetic data generation is right for your needs. There are a number of tools on the market (you can even choose to build your own proprietary platform),take the time to research and land on a synthetic data generation method you feel comfortable with and one that ensures data will retain its structure, format, and fidelity, all while remaining compliant and secure.
